correctness.rationale: One-point PPP void probability gives P(max(y−x/s)≤z)=exp(-s e^{-z}) and independent X_s/s~Exp(1), Z_s−log s~Gumbel. Therefore e^{-Y_s}=s^{-1}E_1U, E_1~Exp(1), U~Unif(0,1). Palm conditioning and affine overtaking region for x′>x gives measure (t-s)e^{-Y_s}, hence conditional Exp holding time and exact persistence Laplace mixture. The two-point Campbell–Mecke crossing intensity integrates v exp(-2y-v) times the no-third-point probability to 1/(2t), proving mean switch count and a.s. local finiteness. The as-yet-unexposed future wedge conditional on all leader history has intensity e^{-Y} dh v e^{-v}dv, so waiting-time clocks and Gamma(2,1) slope increments regenerate; SLLN/Borel–Cantelli yield log T_k/k→2 and N(s,t)/log t→1/2. Multiplicative scaling preserves PPP, giving log-time stationarity; interval void a/(e^a-1) differs from exp(-a/2). Independent quadratures checked persistence for four (s,t) pairs. No discrete finite-population path convergence follows.
